run_gen_data_cli: run the CLI to generate particle collision training, validation, and test datasets
create_ParticleCollisionData: create a ParticleCollisionData instance with configurable particles, colors, grid size, and speed
generate_sample_data: generate labeled particle collision samples as token sequences for model training
check_particle_crossings: check for particle grid-location crossings and record color pairs with positions and timesteps
move_particles_with_bounce: move particles across a bounded grid with random direction changes on boundary collisions
